issues.desc: CHK-005 regression coverage focuses on size-budget/full-flag/env-hatch/JSON-shape but does not explicitly require auditing existing internal callers of these CLI commands (e.g. packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts files that shell out to or assert on milestone_status/story_advance/finding_list/help stdout) for brief-mode breakage. Most spot-checked smoke tests use underlying report objects rather than parsing rendered stdout, so blast radius looks limited, but DEV should explicitly confirm no internal task/smoke consumer parses brief-mode human text output before relying on existing test suite as the only safety net.
